name: Mohamed Zahran
summary: Software engineer at RICOH Europe (formerly CORELIA) shipping six production enterprise systems in parallel, end to end: React 19 and Next.js front ends, NestJS and ASP.NET Core services, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and SQL Server. Builds real-time dashboards, 3D web experiences with React Three Fiber, Arabic RTL/i18n product UIs, and agentic AI systems (LangGraph pipelines, LLM tool-calling with SSE streaming) gated by automated test suites. Previously full-stack engineer for NedSwiss (Switzerland), and frontend lead of GDSC at Shorouk Academy teaching 50+ students.
